What do you like best about Asana?

Asana's project management features work well enough for our team's needs. I like how tasks can be assigned to specific people and due dates can be set. The calendar view is also pretty solid. What do you dislike about Asana?

It took a bit to figure out how to disable it, and I wish there was a more prominent warning about it. It's not a huge deal, but it's something that's bugged me over time.
